AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: This meeting will be held in person at the City Council Chambers of City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to aseims@pvestates.org. Comments received by NOON on Wednesday, March 1, 2023 will be forwarded to the Committee Members and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda. To allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the Committee is requested to fill out a speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Committee minute preparation. When called upon to speak, please state your name for the record. All speakers will receive 3 minutes to speak during public comment or on the item indicated. If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12:00 PM (Noon) on Wednesday, March 1, 2023 to aseims@pvestates.org.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
